CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_AnRP.en: An RPG!\nThere's no time for that!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_AnRP.fr: Un RPG ! Cool… Mais j'ai pas le\ntemps !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Budd.en: All right!\pMy buddy's going to trade me his\nKANGASKHAN for my HAUNTER!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Budd.fr: Ouaiiis !\pMon pote va m'échanger son\nKANGOUREX contre mon GRAVALANCH !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_CanI.en: You can identify POKéMON you get\nin trades by their ID Numbers.
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_CanI.fr: Le numéro d'immatriculation d'un\nPOKéMON sert à l'identifier lors\ld'un échange !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Figh.fr: Un jeu de combat ! Trop coool !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Haun.en: Come on, HAUNTER!\pI love HAUNTER!\nI collect them!\pHuh?\pHAUNTER turned into a different\nPOKéMON while being traded!
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Haun.fr: Cool ! Un GRAVALANCH !\pJ'adore les GRAVALANCH !\pQu… Hein? ?\pGRAVALANCH se transforme en un\nautre POKéMON !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_OTSt.en: Captured POKéMON are registered\nwith an ID No. and the OT.\pOT stands for “Original TRAINER” -\nthe TRAINER that caught it first.
CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_OTSt.fr: Les POKéMON capturés sont\nenregistrés avec No. ID et DO.\pDO = “ Dresseur d'Origine ” :\nle DRESSEUR qui l'a capturé.

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Puzz.fr: Un jeu de puzzle ! J'y suis accro !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_RedG.fr: Rouge et Vert ! Deux jeux POKéMON !

CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Spor.fr: Un jeu de sport ! Vive le foot !

Text_CounterDeclined.en: You're not interested? Come see\nme if you change your mind.

Text_CounterTaught.en: Are you using that COUNTER move\nI taught your POKéMON?
Text_CounterTaught.fr: Vous utilisez la capacité que je\nvous ai apprise ?

Text_CounterTeach.en:
Oh, hi!
I finally finished POKéMON.\pNot done yet? How about I teach
you a good move?\pThe move I have in mind is
COUNTER.\pNot like the one I'm leaning on,
mind you!
Text_CounterTeach.fr:
Oh, salut !
J'ai enfin fini POKéMON.\pT'as pas fini ? Et si je
t'apprenais une bonne capacité ?\pCelle que j'ai en tête, c'est
RIPOSTE.\pIl faut avoir de la répartie pour
l'utiliser !

Text_CounterWhichMon.en: Which POKéMON should I teach\nCOUNTER to?
